question.text: A travelling acoustic wave frequency $500 \mathrm{Hz}$ is moving along the positive $x$ -direction with a velocity of $300 \mathrm{ms}^{-1}$. The phase difference between two points $x_{1}$ and $x_{2}$ is $60^{\circ} .$ Then the minimum separation between the two points is

solution.text:
By using the relation, $v=v \lambda$
We have, $\quad \lambda=\frac{V}{v}=\frac{300}{500}=\frac{3}{5} \mathrm{m}$
The phase difference, $\phi=\frac{2 \pi}{\lambda}(\Delta x)$ $\Rightarrow \quad \frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{2 \pi \times 5}{3}(\Delta x) \Rightarrow \Delta x=\frac{1}{10} m=10 \mathrm{cm}$
